job.title: Senior PHP Developer (Inbound) - CZ/PL
job.description:
ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL — we're the tech-powered growth partner for ecommerce brands, running 12+ owned fulfillment centers across the US, Canada, the UK, and Europe so our merchants can stress less and grow more.

 

We are ShipMonk, and we provide logistics services in order fulfillment. Our main business is in the USA, but our modern platform is built by the Product Development team in Prague.

Here at ShipMonk, we process up to 100,000 orders per day in our peak season. Our book of business has more than 1,500 clients which are small and medium e-shops, mostly based in the US. We offer the ShipMonk platform as the solution for the whole process.  It covers everything from stocking the items to shipping the ready packages to all corners of the world!

The Opportunity
We are currently looking for a Senior (or above) PHP Developer to join our Product Development team in the Czech Republic or Poland. ShipMonk is a leader in e-commerce fulfillment, providing a comprehensive platform for stocking, processing, and shipping orders globally. While our business core is in the USA, our technical foundation is built and scaled by our engineers in Prague. We currently support over 1,500 clients and manage a high-volume environment that processes up to 100,000 orders per day during peak seasons.

Our Inbound domain powers the journey of every product entering ShipMonk’s network. Connecting suppliers, merchants, carriers, and warehouse operations in real time. You’ll design systems where speed, accuracy, and visibility are not buzzwords but measurable outcomes. Your code directly influences how fast businesses can sell and how reliably customers receive their orders.

We are transitioning from a high-growth scale-up to a mature, domain-driven architecture. The real work here isn't just shipping features; it’s orchestrating a distributed system that communicates with autonomous robots, iOS-based warehouse hardware, and conveyors in real-time. We are looking for engineers who care about race conditions, SQL optimization at the terabyte scale, and designing systems that survive the "Black Friday" surge without manual intervention.

The Stack
We maintain a highly automated, modern environment. Our main backend application provides a REST-like API for a diverse ecosystem of clients including web applications, autonomous robots, iOS picker devices, and automatic conveyors.

Backend & DB: PHP 8.5, Symfony 7.4, Doctrine ORM 3, and MySQL 8 (terabyte-sized).
Infrastructure: Everything is dockerized for local development and deployed to AWS-hosted Kubernetes via Argo CD multiple times a day.
Workflow & CI/CD: We utilize a monorepo and GitLab CI with a comprehensive suite of checks (PHPStan, PHP_CodeSniffer, PHPUnit, migration check, security scans). We automate our own coding rules through dozens of custom PHPStan rules and sniffs.
Testing & Reliability: We maintain over 15,000 database integration tests with independent datasets. Production is verified through two-round reviews.
Observability: We handle HA, failover, and autoscaling across all services supported by DataDog, Sentry, and Opsgenie.
The Impact
We don’t manage your hours; we manage outcomes. We value technical excellence paired with a business-oriented mindset. You are expected to:

Engineering for Impact: You understand that code is a tool to solve business problems. You can weigh the trade-offs between technical "perfection" and the practical needs of the business, ensuring your work directly helps ShipMonk grow and stay reliable.
Architectural Ownership: You aren't just a coder; you are a system designer. You will take full responsibility for the technical design and implementation of features that handle high concurrency and mission-critical warehouse logic.
Data-Driven Performance: With a database in the terabyte range, SQL optimization is part of the daily routine. You will focus on building high-availability services where failover and autoscaling are standard requirements.
High Signal, Low Noise: Our culture is built on deep work and asynchronous clarity via Asana. We keep meetings to the absolute minimum so you can focus on high-leverage engineering.
Technical Rigor: You will participate in a strict two-round review process and maintain our high standards for automated documentation. We also contribute back to the community by open-sourcing our best tools (https://github.com/shipmonk-rnd).
ShipMonk is a place where your engineering decisions have a visible, immediate impact on how goods move around the world. We are looking for colleagues who are ready to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and build the future of logistics technology with us. If you are looking for a role where technical complexity meets real-world scale, we look forward to hearing from you.

Ready to move the physical world with code? [Apply via our recruiter – No Cover Letter Needed, Just your Profile/GitHub]

 

About ShipMonk

ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL; we're a growth partner for merchants. We provide cutting-edge technology and a network of owned and operated fulfillment centers that empower high-growth ecommerce and DTC brands to stress less and grow more. With over 2,500 employees across five countries, we're on a mission to revolutionize fulfillment by providing everything from the fastest click-to-delivery and real-time inventory to custom solutions—all with a merchant-first mindset.

Why ShipMonk?

We believe in building for the long term, and our success is powered by five key differentiators that help us become true partners to our merchants.

Global Fulfillment Network: Our 12+ owned and operated fulfillment centers span the US, Canada, the U.K., and Mainland Europe. We never outsource, ensuring quality and consistency.
● Proprietary Technology: We've eliminated the need for tribal knowledge with our AI-powered platform. It provides a real-time, unified view of inventory and orders, giving our merchants the control and visibility they need to succeed.
● Unrivaled Support: We provide hands-on, "mom and pop" support with a global reach. Our dedicated teams are on-site at every fulfillment center, ready to jump into action.
● Transparent Pricing: We believe in honest, long-term partnerships. Our all- inclusive pricing means predictable costs, with no hidden fees or surprises.
● Committed to the Future: We invest over $10 million annually in research and development to ensure our technology and services continually evolve, helping merchants plant roots with a partner who is here to stay.
Our Core Values

Our values are the heart of our culture. We're looking for individuals who embody these principles every day.

Merchant-first: We handle the logistics so our merchants can focus on what they do best—growing their business.
People make ShipMonk: We believe in our team and invest in our people.
Own it: We take ownership of our work, our mistakes, and our successes.
Get sh*t done: We're a fast-paced, high-growth company that values action and results.
Change the score: We challenge the status quo, constantly innovating and improving.
 

ShipMonk is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Why Kimchi?
Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any LLM you pick.

Kimchi Studio
Studio is where your team's agents work together: a desktop app that brings autonomous coding agents, model orchestration, and your entire toolchain into one collaborative UI. Multiple agents on separate branches side by side with native git worktree support. Every agent action visible, diffable,
and undoable. Local first on your machine, remote sessions when you need them.
You'll own features end to end: design, implementation, testing, production rollout. Most projects ship in 1-4 weeks. You'll work directly with product and other engineering teams on problems that don't have textbook solutions.

You might be a fit if…
You've personally driven a complex product feature from idea to shipped, and you can tell that story with receipts.
You're a full-stack engineer: TypeScript where the product lives (Electron/React UI, Node services) and Go where the backend lives. Strong in one, ready to go deep in the other, and honest about which is which.
You have deep debugging and performance instincts: when the app janks or a query slows down, you find the cause through query profiles and flame graphs.
You care about UX, speed, and polish. In a desktop app every millisecond is visible, and you push back when something feels wrong.

Bonus: shipping Electron apps at scale (updates, code signing, multi-platform builds), Kubernetes internals, or building your own AI workflows and harnesses at home.
What’s in it for you?
Competitive salary (€6,500 - €9,000 gross, depending on the level of experience).
Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.
Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology
Equity options.
Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.
Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. 
Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.
Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.
Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.
Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.
Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Screening call with Recruiter
Hiring Manager interview
Technical interview (system design)
Live coding
Culture Check interview with an executive

job.title: Developer Team Lead
job.description:
At INGENIOUS.BUILD, we have developed a top-notch platform for companies in the real estate and construction industries worldwide. Our platform enables companies to easily manage all aspects of their projects from start to finish, both internally and with other project participants. 

Joining INGENIOUS.BUILD means embarking on an incredible journey to create the first cloud application for managing the entire lifecycle of a real estate construction project. You'll be building what some consider the holy grail of construction project management. It's a big, bold, and audacious endeavor, and if you have what it takes, you'll play a direct role in its development. 

And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll be directly involved in its development. The rest, as they say, will be history...

INGENIOUS.BUILD is building the operating system for construction and real estate development. We work with some of the largest organizations in the world, and the features our engineers build help teams manage some of the biggest investments being made today. If we succeed, a large share of the world's important infrastructure will be planned, built, and reported on through our platform.

We're a product-driven engineering organization. Engineers here don't just take tickets. They understand the customer, challenge proposed solutions, and shape what gets built. We're also going all-in on AI. We treat it as a way to deliver more value to customers, not just to write code faster.

About the role
We're looking for a Developer Team Lead to lead one of our web product teams. This is a small, senior, highly autonomous team. You won't be supervising juniors. You'll be a partner to experienced engineers: bringing the team together, building the right processes, and keeping the team efficient, aligned, and focused on the right problems.

The role combines hands-on engineering and leadership. You'll write code, make architectural decisions, and lead the team's AI adoption, while also owning people management, planning, and prioritization. You'll report directly to the Engineering Director. You'll work closely with a Product Manager and a dedicated Product Designer, and alongside other team leads and our DevOps team.

What you'll do
Lead the team

Run regular 1:1s, monitor performance, and support each engineer's growth, including compensation and career conversations.
Own the team's high-level planning and prioritization, together with Product and Design.
Build and improve the processes that keep a senior team synchronized and effective, without adding bureaucracy.
Take part in hiring, onboarding, and performance reviews.
 

Drive AI adoption

Lead the AI transformation in your team. Set the pace instead of waiting for it to be defined for you.
Go beyond basic prompting. Use AI to research unfamiliar systems, identify gaps, automate repetitive work, and speed up delivery.
Experiment with new tools and workflows, standardize what works, and share it with your team and across engineering.
Look for ways AI can deliver business value: lower costs, shorter delivery times, higher quality, and solutions that weren't practical before.
Build the product

Stay hands-on: write code, review code, and own the technical direction of your team's modules.
Make sound architectural decisions in a large modular monolith.
Use customer insights to challenge solutions, propose improvements, and help decide what to build and in what order.
Keep improving the codebase by reducing legacy code, adding tests, and keeping dependencies current.
Our tech and engineering approach
Stack: PHP 8.5, Laravel 13, PostgreSQL
Architecture: a large modular monolith. Modules communicate through facades, adapters, or events, which keeps boundaries clear. More complex modules use DDD.
Philosophy: code that's easy to test and reason about. Business logic lives in clear PHP classes, separate from the framework, with no "magic."
Quality: pipelines with PHPStan, PHPCS, and unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, all supporting automatic deployments. DevOps owns infrastructure, so you can focus on building.
AI tooling: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and whatever else helps us move faster. We revisit our tools regularly because they improve quickly.
What we're looking for
Must-haves

People management experience. You've already led developers, including 1:1s, performance, and team processes. This isn't a first step into management.
Strong backend engineering. Advanced PHP 8.1+ with Laravel or Symfony, and experience building large, scalable applications.
Technical leadership and architecture. You've led the technical side of complex projects: making design decisions, not just carrying them out.
Hands-on AI adoption. You already use AI tools in your daily engineering work and are excited to push further. You don't need deep AI expertise, but you do need the energy to lead this.
Product mindset. You care about the "why," think about business impact, and want to shape solutions, not just implement specs.
Testing. Solid experience with PHPUnit and a good testing strategy across unit, integration, and functional tests.
English at B2 level or higher.
Nice-to-haves

Experience with modular monoliths (microservices experience also counts)
Practical experience with Domain-Driven Design
Background in SaaS, especially large systems like ERP, CRM, or CMS
Experience in startups or scale-ups where engineers work directly with product decisions
The kind of person who thrives here

Curious. You enjoy learning, and you revisit your opinions as tools and practices change.
Proactive. You spot problems and opportunities and act on them. You can point to improvements you proposed that were adopted.
Driven. You have the grit to take on hard problems and want to be part of something that could reshape an industry.
A partner. Senior engineers respect you because you support them, not because you manage them closely.
What we offer
Stock options, so you share in the company's growth
Flexible working hours and a minimal-meetings culture
Unlimited PTO
A high-performance company laptop
One-time $500 budget to set up your workspace
$50 per month for education, rolling over until year-end
Licenses for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and PhpStorm
We're fired up to learn more about you to see how you can help us on our mission! 

We genuinely look forward to receiving your application after submitting your information a member from the Recruitment Team will reach out accordingly.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Context Layer
job.description:
About Starburst
Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai.

About the role

Starburst's Enterprise Context Layer turns scattered data into governed, versioned Data Products — business definitions, access policy, and lineage built in — so BI tools, applications, and AI agents all work from the same trusted answer. As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you'll build the backend services that harvest business context from where it already lives, govern it through a certification and versioning workflow, and serve it to both people and AI agents across the platform. This is a fast-evolving product area, so you'll have real influence over foundational architecture decisions rather than executing against a fully-specified spec. We're looking for builders with strong product instincts — engineers who care as much about the customer outcome as the technical solution, and who are comfortable moving across the stack when that's the fastest path to shipping value, even though the core of this role is Java-based backend work.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Starburst you will:

Design, build, and operate backend services that collect and reconcile business context from a variety of existing systems into governed Context Studio.
Build and evolve the certification and versioning workflow that lets teams trust a single definition of their metrics and data.
Contribute to the APIs and MCP-based integrations that let AI agents and BI tools query certified context directly.
Own reliability and data consistency for services that merge and reconcile information from many sources at once.
Partner directly with product on what gets built, not just how — and pick up frontend, tooling, or other full-stack work when it's the fastest way to unblock a feature or validate an idea.
Work cross-functionally with teams across the platform, including those building AI-powered features, to ship context-aware capabilities.
Provide considerate, timely review of your peers' pull requests and design proposals.
Some of the things we look for:

A builder's mindset with strong product thinking — you care about the "why" behind a feature, not just the elegance of the implementation.
Extensive software development experience with Java, with the versatility and willingness to work across the full stack — frontend, tooling, infra — when the problem calls for it.
Experience designing, building, and operating distributed backend services in production.
Experience designing and operating REST APIs.
Experience modeling and serving graph-structured or richly-relational data 
Experience integrating LLMs into backend systems — structured extraction, prompt-based enrichment, or evaluating LLM output for correctness — relevant to how we help harvest and enrich context.
Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-evolving problem spaces where architecture is still being defined.
Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools in real production work, with the judgment to apply proper guardrails — testing, review, verification steps — so speed doesn't come at the cost of code quality or correctness.
Demonstrated experience with software engineering best practices.
Bonus: experience with data catalogs, semantic layers, or metadata/governance systems (e.g., dbt, Collibra) is a plus, not required.
Ability to Travel: This role will require 25% in-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.
Where could this role be based?

This role is based in our Warsaw office and follows a hybrid model, with an expectation of being onsite 1-2 days per week.
Build your career at Starburst
All-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we’re empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry-proven technology and unprecedented success, All-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry –  and the future. 

Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more. 

We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All-Stars to show up authentically.

Starburst provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state
 or local laws.
